artworks.title: Salmoneus Imitating Zeus (drawing after Chicago crater)
artworks.artist: Ernest Arthur Gardner (after Attic red-figure column-krater)
artworks.description: AJA plate after Art Institute of Chicago 1889.16: Salmoneus with sword and mock thunderbolt, chains trailing his chariot — Iris watching the king who would be Zeus.

popCulture.title: Salmoneus
popCulture.description: The king who dragged bronze pots behind his chariot to fake Zeus' thunder remains the emblem of hubris punished by a real bolt.
